title: Glazed Fish with Honey Curry Sauce
description: A flavorful and aromatic dish featuring pan-seared fish glazed with a sweet honey curry sauce, gluten-free.

ingredients.name: Fish (any white fish, e.g., cod, tilapia)
Glazed (e.g., soy sauce, maple syrup, or honey)

instructions: Season the fish fillets with salt.
Heat olive oil in an oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the fish fillets for 2-3 minutes per side, then transfer the skillet to the preheated oven.
Bake the fish for 8-10 minutes or until cooked through.
While the fish cooks, whisk together honey, glazed, and curry powder in a small bowl.
Remove the skillet from the oven and brush the honey curry sauce over the fish fillets.
Return the skillet to the oven and bake for an additional 2-3 minutes or until the sauce is caramelized.
Serve the glazed fish hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
